hypotheses.statement: Preparedness-first positioning (not survivalist, not commodity) is the strongest differentiator for Infenergy.
Working parents in storm-prone regions are the highest-value segment.
Education-first social content builds trust faster than product-push content in this category.

Combined U.S. TAM across power bank (~$15B), solar lighting (~$10B), and rechargeable battery (~$18B) categories may exceed $40B; figures are founder-pitch estimates, unverified against independent market research.
Roughly 30 million U.S. homes may be at high risk of power loss, and over 5 million Americans experienced 3+ day outages in the past year, per founder pitch estimate; unverified.

Seniors/caregivers prioritizing continuity and safety, and first responders, may be distinct high-value audience sub-segments worth modeling separately (already named in founder_brand_manifesto.json audience_segments but not yet distinctly represented in the compiled profile's 5 audience_segments).
